summary: Net Power Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 8, 2026, NET Power, LLC, OpCo and the Company entered three integrated Transaction Agreements with Baker Hughes affiliates Nuovo Pignone S.r.l. and Nuovo Pignone International S.r.l.: a JDA Suspension Agreement, a Commercial Agreement Suspension Agreement, and a First Amendment to the License Agreement. The agreements indefinitely suspend utility-scale oxy-combustion development and commercialization arrangements, terminate specified La Porte Demonstration Facility access and exclusivity rights, preserve NP's exclusive utility-scale equipment license, and establish revised industrial-scale licensing. No plant deployment obligation, royalty amount, or royalty assurance was agreed. No board recommendation or advisor disclosed.
